बॉक्स ऑफिस पर ऐसा गदर मचा है कि सब देखते रह गए 🔥
नितीश तिवारी के निर्देशन में बनी फिल्म Ramayana ने कमाई के मामले में नया इतिहास रच दिया है 🎬
Sacnilk की रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक फिल्म ने दूसरे संडे को 75 करोड़ रुपये का ताबड़तोड़ कलेक्शन किया है 💰
इसके साथ ही फिल्म ने Ranveer Singh की Dhurandhar 2 के 68 करोड़ रुपये के रिकॉर्ड को पछाड़कर सबसे बड़ा दूसरा संडे दर्ज किया है 🚀
फिल्म का कुल बॉक्स ऑफिस कलेक्शन अब 760.60 करोड़ रुपये पहुंच गया है 📈
बता दें कि यह फिल्म Jawan, Stree 2 और Animal जैसी फिल्मों के लाइफटाइम कलेक्शन को भी पीछे छोड़ चुकी है 🌟
क्या आपने अभी तक थिएटर्स में जाकर यह फिल्म देखी या नहीं? 🍿

ctx.title: Ramayana box office collection day 11: Ranbir Kapoor, Yash's film beats Dhurandhar 2 to record Bollywood's biggest 2nd Sunday
ctx.summary: Ramayana Part 1 is directed by Nitesh Tiwari. The film also stars Sai Pallavi, Ravie Dubey, Kunal Kapoor and others in key roles.
ctx.text:
Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana continues to dominate the box office, with its second weekend bringing another major milestone for the film. Despite the Diwali holiday period coming to an end, the Ranbir Kapoor , Sai Pallavi and Yash -starrer has maintained its momentum and witnessed further growth over the weekend. The film has now registered a record-breaking collection on its second Sunday, setting a new benchmark for Bollywood releases.
Advance bookings for Ramayana opened on Dussehra, 15 days before release. By the time of its release, the film had already sold tickets worth ₹ 200 crore worldwide. The film went on to collect ₹ 64.85 crore in India on its first day of release, becoming the fourth-highest opening in Bollywood history. The film then earned ₹ 107 crore net on Monday and ₹ 94 crore net on Tuesday, both the highest in Indian cinema history.
As per the latest update on Sacnilk, Ramayana managed to collect ₹ 75 crore on its second Sunday, showing further growth than Saturday's ₹ 72.90 crore haul. This brings the total box office collection of the film to ₹ 760.60 crore .
Ramayana has now delivered the biggest second Sunday for a Bollywood film at the box office, beating Ranveer Singh's Dhurandhar 2. The spy thriller, which released in theatres earlier this year in March, had collected ₹ 68 crore. The highest second Sunday haul is still held by ₹ 76.60 crore.
Meanwhile, the film has already surpassed the lifetime haul of Shah Rukh Khan's Jawan ( ₹ 643.87 crore) and Rajkummar Rao's Stree 2 ( ₹ 625.27 crore). It also overtook Chhaava (which stood at ₹ 601.57 crore). Previously, it had crossed lifetime hauls of Shah Rukh Khan's Pathaan (which stood at ₹ 544.28 crore) and Ranbir Kapoor's previous theatrical release Animal (which stood at ₹ 556.36 crore).
Ramayana is the latest adaptation of Valmiki's epic, one of the world's oldest pieces of literature. It tells the story of Lord Rama, the incarnation of Lord Vishnu and his battle against the asura king Ravana after the latter abducts his wife, Sita.
Produced by Namit Malhotra’s Prime Focus Studios in collaboration with DNEG and Yash’s Monster Mind Creations, Ramayana is planned as a two-part film. The film stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana, Ravie Dubey as Lakshman, and Sunny Deol as Lord Hanuman. The first released worldwide on November 5, 2026, while the second part is set for Diwali 2028.
